name: @btkulka/remote-access
description: People on a remote: who may sign in to a hub's phone remote and what each may reach. The owner on the hub's key, guests each on a key of their own (an invite link or QR), the owner's other computers (peers) on keys of their own with only the calls the host gives peers, sessions kept as hashes in a cookie's stead, and the rules a host applies per person: the calls, settings and events each role gets, the tools and ports a guest may open, the notices a guest sees. Storage and the rule lists are handed in by the host; nothing here knows Benhäus. No runtime dependencies.
